Weighbridge exceptions

Northwick Analytics · invented period report · fictional throughout

Every row below is made up. The table exists so region discovery can be exercised against tabular content, where each cell is a small non-inline element holding text.

Exceptions by depot

Fourteen weeks, invented figures, ordered by count.
Depot Exceptions Most common cause Resolved same shift
Netherby 148 Manifest weight disagrees with the slip 31%
Carrowmoor 121 Customer approval not received before departure 44%
Ferrisgate 96 Seal number transposed on entry 62%
Kellsgate 74 No supervisor on shift to sign off 28%
Marchwood 69 Calibration certificate lapsed 81%
Brantham 38 Manifest weight disagrees with the slip 73%

What the table does not say

  • An exception is not a fault. Most are closed inside twenty minutes and cost nothing.
  • The resolved-same-shift column is the one worth reading, and it is not the one anybody asks about in the monthly pack.
  • Netherby's count is high partly because Netherby records exceptions its neighbours handle informally and never log.
  • No depot in this table is real.

Recommendation

  1. Stop reporting the raw count. It rewards under-logging.
  2. Report the share resolved before the driver leaves, per depot, per shift.
  3. Give the threshold for a customer approval to the customer, not the planner.

Committed as a test fixture. Northwick Analytics, every depot, every figure and every recommendation above are invented, and none of it describes any real operation.
